method.rate: current funding-period rate as published by the exchange (charged at next settlement; may change until then)
method.rate_8h: rate × 8 / interval_h (rows with unknown interval excluded from aggregates)
method.apr_pct: per exchange: rate_8h × 3 × 365 × 100; headline apr_pct = oi_weighted_8h × 3 × 365 × 100 (falls back to avg_8h when no OI weights; see apr_basis). Simple annualization, assumes constant rate
method.aggregate: one contract per exchange (largest OI); avg_8h = simple mean; oi_weighted_8h = Σ(rate_8h × oi_usd)/Σoi_usd
method.settled: actual settlement records collected from each exchange funding-history endpoint; cum = Σ settled rates in window
method.liveness: a funding row is used only if the same contract on the same exchange has a ticker within 1h, open interest within 3h, or a self-collected quote within 3h; rows without such evidence (delisted / settling / zero-turnover contracts that exchanges still list with 0 or an old value) are excluded and listed in coverage.no_liveness_excluded

unavailable.detail: UNAVAILABLE: cswap openInterest 时间戳滞后~7h 且单位无文档，暂不采纳

method.total: SUM(oi_usd) over fresh contracts (non-CME updated within 3h; CME within 120h)
method.usd: linear: contracts × contract_size × mark/last price; inverse: contracts × contract_face_value_usd (or coin amount × price)
method.change_h1_h4: same-contract pairing vs own snapshot nearest to now−W (15-minute snapshots, hourly fallback)
method.change_h24: same-exchange pairing vs hourly snapshot nearest to now−24h (site-wide convention); contracts whose baseline snapshot is a frozen carry-over (identical to the cent in 3 consecutive hourly snapshots, non-CME) are excluded from both sides and reported in frozen_excluded
method.oi_side: as disclosed by each exchange; double = exchange API itself reports open interest as twice the single-sided figure

data.name: US Spot Bitcoin ETF Flows, latest session
data.description: The newest trading session for US spot Bitcoin ETFs (daily Total, original vendor aggregate and the per-fund breakdown) and the last 5 sessions' totals, newest first. The full series is at https://www.tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows/data.json.
data.attribution: The Commoner Bitcoin ETF Tracker by TFTC, tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows
data.sources: SoSoValue (daily aggregates and per-fund flows); issuer disclosures as tabulated by Farside Investors (per-fund history through mid-2026); mempool.space (BTC price, ~21:00 UTC mark).
data.totalDefinition: netFlowUsd sums the listed perEtfUsd funds; without a breakdown it uses vendorNetFlowUsd. Known incomplete SoSoValue sessions are withheld. Vendor totals may differ. Displayed figures are rounded.
